note: Name is one register-level fact per variable. Edition 100 already delivers 'Reviewed label'; renaming only edition 99 makes the two agree.
fails_if: `compile_occurrence_corrections` stops applying the reviewed `[[errata.field]]` name to edition 99, so 'GenericVar' and 'Reviewed label' conflict and ANSWER forms no states

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers ANSWER in edition 99 (2009, CVID 20) named 'GenericVar' and in edition 100 (2017, CVID 21) named 'Reviewed label'.
